title: Quantification of salt-induced changes in Root System Architecture in Arabidopsis
author: Magdalena M Julkowska
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zkqf4vw

steps.title: Prepare Germination Media
steps.instruction: Prepare 1L of media containing 2.2 g Murashi-Skoog, 5 g sucrose, and 1 g MES Monohydrate.

substeps.instruction: Adjust pH to 5.8 using KOH.
Add 10g Dashin agar directly into the bottle after pH adjustment.
Autoclave using a liquid sterilization cycle.
Pour 40 ml per square plate (12x12cm).
Dry plates in the laminar hood for 1 to 3 hours to reduce surface condensation.
Place plates in plastic bags, seal with tape, label with name and date, and store at 4°C.

steps.title: Sterilize Seeds
steps.instruction: Sterilize seeds using a bleach solution and rinse with sterile water.

substeps.instruction: Soak seeds in 50% Bleach (1:1 ratio of household bleach and MQ water) for 10 minutes, shaking gently occasionally without vortexing.
Transfer to a laminar hood and wash seeds 5-8 times with sterile MQ using a 1ml pipette.
Store seeds at 4°C overnight to ensure equal germination (do not store longer than one week).

steps.title: Plate the Seeds
steps.instruction: Sow approximately 150-200 seeds per 1/2 MS agar plate.

substeps.instruction: Transfer seeds and plates into a clean laminar hood.
Use a sterile 1ml pipette with manual volume control to suck up the seed suspension.
Gently touch the pipette tip to the plate surface to deposit seeds; reduce volume while touching if seeds do not release.
Allow plates to dry in the hood until water droplets evaporate, placing agar plates on top of the plate lid for 5 minutes.
Close plates and wrap the ends with leukopor tape.

steps.title: Germinate Seedlings
steps.instruction: Incubate plates in a growth chamber to allow germination.

substeps.instruction: Stack plates at approximately a 70-degree angle in a ribbed tray.
Set growth chamber to 16h light, 8h dark, 22°C, and 60% humidity.

steps.title: Prepare Treatment Plates
steps.instruction: Prepare salt-containing media using the basic media recipe.

substeps.instruction: Create media with 0, 75, and 125 mM NaCl (add NaCl after pH measurement).
Pour plates as described in the germination media step.
Dry in the laminar hood for 1 to 3 hours.

steps.title: Transfer Seedlings to Treatment Media
steps.instruction: Four days after germination, transfer seedlings to the treatment plates (0, 75, or 125 mM NaCl).

substeps.instruction: Use sterile or freshly opened yellow pipette tips for transfer.
Aim for at least 12 replicas per condition per genotype.
Divide each plate into two halves, with each half containing 2 seedlings of each genotype.
Label the plate: upper left corner with plate number, upper right corner with composition (0/75/125 mM NaCl), and lower numbers with encoded genotype.
Seal plates with leukopor tape.

steps.title: Mark and Initial Scan
steps.instruction: Mark root positions and perform an initial scan before returning plates to the growth chamber (Percival).

substeps.instruction: Use a permanent marker to put a dot at the position of the main root tip.

steps.title: Scan and Analyze Root Architecture
steps.instruction: Monitor root growth through periodic scanning and software analysis.

substeps.instruction: Scan plates every two days until plants are 12 days old or root architecture becomes too complex.
Scan at 200 dpi resolution using a black background.
Analyze root system architecture using Smart Root or EZ-Rhizo (Windows only).
